Hi there - gentle nudge on the CRLF multi-line string roundtrip whenever you have a moment.

An all-CRLF document with a multi-line string was roundtripping with mixed endings: CRLF kept inside the string while structural newlines re-emitted as LF (`Fixes #1213`).

This normalizes CRLF to LF when decoding multi-line basic and multi-line literal strings in `crates/toml_parser/src/decoder/string.rs`, and re-encodes the string raw repr with the same normalization in `crates/toml_edit/src/parser/value.rs`, which the TOML 1.0.0 multi-line string rules permit.

Tests in `crates/toml_edit/tests/testsuite/edit.rs` pin the failing roundtrip cases (`crlf_multiline_string_in_crlf_document_roundtrips` and the literal variant) plus already-uniform controls; decoder unit coverage sits alongside in `toml_parser`.

The branch follows the repo CONTRIBUTING shape with a test commit first, then the fix commit; local `cargo test --workspace`, fmt, clippy, and docs checks were green (fuzz crate excluded locally for clang).

Glad to split the decoder vs edit changes differently, or tighten the normalization scope, if that would ease review.

Whenever it fits is fine - still ready from my end.
